apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

Built from YTLite plus a custom tweak (NoShortsEver) that unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in every feed and search result
• Launch-resume into the Shorts player

Also inherits YTLite's ad-blocking and background playback. Based on stock YouTube 21.28.3.
